records.text: Brooklyn Beckham said his parents had tried endlessly to ruin his relationship since before the wedding and that his mother canceled making Nicola Peltz's dress at the last minute.
records.speaker: Brooklyn Beckham

appearances.snippet: My parents have been trying endlessly to ruin my relationship since before my wedding and has not stopped. ... My mom canceled making Nicola (Nicola Peltz)'s dress in the 11th hour despite how excited she was to wear her design, ... forcing her to urgently find a new dress.

verification.notes: The full contemporaneous reproduction of Beckham's Instagram statement says his parents tried endlessly to ruin the relationship and that his mother canceled making Nicola's dress at the eleventh hour. This verifies what he posted; the underlying allegations remain disputed.

sources.title: Brooklyn Beckham’s bombshell statement in full as he hits out at ‘controlling’ parents
sources.relevance: Reproduces both claims from Beckham's Instagram statement.

records.text: Candace Owens said evidence showed Nicola Peltz's wedding dress had been in production for a year, casting doubt on Brooklyn Beckham's claim that the cancellation came at the eleventh hour.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Somebody then pulled up a receipt and her dress was in the making for a year. ... So I don't know what he considers to be the 11th hour.

verification.notes: Vogue's contemporaneous wedding-dress report states that the Valentino gown resulted from a year's worth of conversations, two Rome trips, and two U.S. fittings. That supports Owens's statement that a public receipt showed roughly a year of work and explains why she said it cast doubt on an eleventh-hour account.

sources.title: Nicola Peltz’s Custom Valentino Couture Wedding Dress Was Like “A Work Of Art”
sources.relevance: States the dress culminated a year of conversations with Valentino.

records.text: Brooklyn Beckham accused his parents of repeatedly pressuring and attempting to bribe him before his wedding to sign away rights to his name, and said his refusal affected a payday and how they treated him.
records.speaker: Brooklyn Beckham

appearances.snippet: Weeks before our big day, ... my parents repeatedly pressured and attempted to bribe me into signing away the rights to my name, which would have affected me, ... my wife and our future children. ... My holdout affected the payday and they have never treated me the same since.

verification.notes: The full contemporaneous reproduction of Beckham's Instagram statement includes the alleged pressure and attempted bribe over rights to his name, plus the claimed payday and treatment consequences. This verifies the accusation as published, not the underlying private negotiations.

sources.title: Brooklyn Beckham’s bombshell statement in full as he hits out at ‘controlling’ parents
sources.relevance: Reproduces the rights, pressure, payday, and treatment claims.

records.text: Brooklyn Beckham accused his mother of hijacking a planned romantic dance with his wife and dancing inappropriately on him in front of 500 wedding guests, causing humiliation that led the couple to renew their vows.
records.speaker: Brooklyn Beckham

appearances.snippet: My mom hijacked my first dance with my wife, ... which had been planned weeks in advance to a romantic love song. ... In front of our 500 wedding guests, ... Marc Anthony called me to the stage wherein the schedule was planned to be my romantic dance with my wife, but instead my mom was waiting to dance with me and she danced very inappropriately on me in front of everyone. I have never felt more uncomfortable or humiliated in my entire life. We wanted to renew our vows so that we could create new memories of our wedding day that bring us joy and happiness and not anxiety and embarrassment.

verification.notes: The full contemporaneous reproduction of Beckham's Instagram statement includes the hijacked-dance allegation, 500 guests, alleged inappropriate dancing, humiliation, and the reason given for renewing vows. This verifies the post; later eyewitness accounts debate details of the dance.

records.text: Candace Owens cited Vogue's wedding account as saying Brooklyn Beckham and Nicola Peltz had their first dance to 'Only Fools Rush In' before other dancing and Marc Anthony's late-night set.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: When dinner, ... which was masterminded by Thierry is on both culinary and event design was over, the newlyweds had their first dance to Only Fools Rush In, ... which was performed by rising South African artist Lloyiso. Then the friends then joined the young couple on the dance. ... And then it tells us that Marc Anthony took over the DJ decks to close out the celebrations.

verification.notes: Vogue's contemporaneous wedding report says the newlyweds had their first dance to 'Only Fools Rush In,' then friends joined them on the dance floor, and Marc Anthony later took over the DJ decks to close the celebrations. That matches the cited sequence.

records.text: Candace Owens accused Nicola Peltz of repeatedly suing people when she does not get what she wants, including a current case against a mobile dog-grooming company after her elderly Chihuahua died.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Nicola (Nicola Peltz), it's what she does. It's a thing. She sues people over and over again when she doesn't get what she wants. ... Case in point, a lawsuit that's currently going through the court system where ... and so she's been suing she's been suing this place that literally just cleans dogs

verification.notes: At the episode's January 2026 time context, Peltz's lawsuit against HoundSpa over her Chihuahua's death was active and well documented. The broad assertion that she repeatedly sues whenever she does not get what she wants is motive-based commentary and is not established by court records. The suit was later discontinued in 2026.

records.text: Candace Owens said an autopsy found that Nicola Peltz's Chihuahua had fluid in its brain, which Owens characterized as typical for Chihuahuas and small dogs.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And they got the autopsy and turns out the dog had what chihuahuas get a lot of, which is fluid in the brains, in the brain. ... And that's very typical for chihuahuas and small dogs.

verification.notes: Transcript context was reviewed and live searches were performed. Public reporting says Nala had fluid in her lungs and neurological injury, and 2025 court reporting said the necropsy report still had to be authorized for release. No accessible necropsy or reliable source confirms fluid in the brain as the autopsy finding, so the claim cannot be verified; absence of confirmation is not treated as false.

records.text: Candace Owens said Nicola Peltz went through three wedding contracts, one of which led to reciprocal lawsuits between her father and the contractor.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: She's been involved in a lot of legal spats pertaining to her. ... To her wedding, she went through three different wedding contracts, ... one of which her father sued and they sued back and said, your daughter is awful.

verification.notes: Court reporting confirms Nelson Peltz sued wedding planners and the planners countersued. However, later reporting says the couple used four wedding planners, not three. The reciprocal-litigation portion is supported, while the count is contradicted.
